creator: Mercedes Solla; SFCW data provided by Screening Eagle Technologies
material: Laboratory reinforced concrete; real measurements, not simulation; not park soil
x_axis: SEG-Y coordinates are zero; x is inferred from nominal 2 scans/cm. All traces retained.
length_note: CSV says 1.85 m; 372 traces at 5 mm infer endpoint 1.855 m. All numerical traces retained; plot x-limit is 1.85 m.
sample_count_note: Actual export:655 samples. Article reportedly states653; actual export retained.
time_zero_note: Time0 is the first exported sample, not a calibrated surface/reflection zero. No shift or depth conversion was applied.

processing.input: Original measured instrument time-domain export, not diagnostic 400–900 MHz filtered array
processing.background: Arithmetic mean of all 372 traces at each sample subtracted from each trace
processing.normalization: Shared symmetric +/-99th percentile of absolute background-removed values in 0–6 ns
processing.display: gray colormap, nearest-neighbour pixel display; no spatial/time resampling
processing.other_processing: No extra frequency filter, gain, warp, fitted curve, time-zero correction or depth conversion

interpretation: Measured hyperbolic reflections in a known rebar specimen. The figure does not assign a diameter or depth to each visible arch and is not a quantitative validation of the park model.
